description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Front or Rear Axle Housing Breather Valve.
This Valve is located directly on top of the front and rear differential cases.
If you have milky oil then water is getting into your diff and this is probably the problem.
Old Valves allow the water to get in and destroy your Differential.
So if you take your Samurai into water or mud you need this Valve!
This is an easy and inexpensive fix that will keep the water out of your Differential Case.
This Valve will work on the Front or Rear Axle Housing.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Breather Cap
Qty 1 – Valve Spring
Qty 1 – Valve
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
